environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 in COUNT mode for baseline telemetry, (2) a custom rule at priority 50 that inspects QUERY_STRING with a RegexPatternSet matching patterns including UNION\s+SELECT, single-quote followed by OR/AND with equality patterns, and comment sequences (--|\/\*), with action BLOCK and CloudWatch metric 'CustomSQLiBlock', (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 200 in BLOCK mode with sensitivity level HIGH. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. ALB access logs are shipped to S3 with a 5-minute delivery interval.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL association
